environment: **Source control**: Trusted repos are github.com/aria-amini/* only, worked on in git worktrees (the home directory itself is not a repo). dotfiles, toolkit and infra are public; app repos may be private, so treat repo contents as private unless a repo is known to be public
**Default / protected branches**: main; PRs squash-merge. Never rewrite or force-push main or tags
**Secrets management**: OpenBao on Railway holds every app's secrets. Never read or print secret values
**Network posture**: Sessions normally run on a Lima Ubuntu VM reached over Tailscale; tailnet hostnames are trusted internal domains

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: credentials and similar material, such as .env* files, ~/.claude/.credentials.json, and ~/.config/openbao; do not share them outside the repo owner and the tools that already use them
**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development
